name: Scenario 6: Festivals and Challenges
background_en: As more groups rise across the scene, idol festivals have become the industry's biggest stages—and none loom larger than TIF (Tokyo Idol Festival). Take the challenges head-on, win the crowd, and grow your fans.
background_zh: 随着各组崭露头角，偶像音乐节愈发成为行业最大舞台——其中最负盛名的，莫过于 TIF（东京偶像节）。迎接挑战，征服观众，把每一次演出变成粉丝的增长。
